# Completion Rule

## Summary
What a learner must do for a cohort to count as completed: minimum attendance %, all required assignments graded, N quizzes passed, minimum overall letter. Declared once on the Course; evaluated per Enrollment by `evaluateCompletion()`.

## Usage
```ts
import { CompletionRuleField } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/academy/completion-rule-field';
@field completionRule = contains(CompletionRuleField);
```
Consumed by Course; read by Learner Progress and Issue Certificate.

## Non-goals
Does not store any learner result — that is Completion Evaluation. Does not express custom logic beyond the four clauses; use customNote for instructions.
